# Anne Shirley & Priscilla Grant

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) — intimate friends at Queen's Academy · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), +5 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) settles into student life at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy), forming new friendships with [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) while keeping up her academic rivalry with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She spends visits with [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) and keeps her exams in perspective as commencement approaches.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P15](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0015)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drive around canvassing their assigned road to raise money for painting the hall on behalf of the newly formed [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). They encounter various eccentric neighbors, including grim Miss Eliza, her optimistic sister Catherine, a stressed husband in an apron, and an overly neat Mrs. White.
>
> — v2 · VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P0](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0000), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P12](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0012)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) invites [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to celebrate her spring "adopted birthday" with a picnic walk through the woods alongside [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md). On Saturday, the four girls explore new paths, name a woodland pool [Crystal Lake](../codex/places.md#crystal-lake), and discover Hester Gray's forgotten overgrown garden, where [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) tells Hester's tragic and romantic story.
>
> — v2 · XIII A Golden Picnic

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P1](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0001), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P8](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0008), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P44](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0044), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P51](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0051)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) discuss the life and memory of [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md) while lingering in her garden. Afterwards, they explore the nearby woods and fields, enjoying a lunch by a brook where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) share poetic thoughts on nature and souls before returning home at sunset.
>
> — v2 · XIII A Golden Picnic

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P56](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0056), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P61](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0061), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P68](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0068), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P73](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0073)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) excitedly prepare [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and cook a feast to entertain Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), but a series of mishaps occurs, including [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) ruining the lemon pies and accidentally knocking a heavy conch shell onto Miss Barry's borrowed platter. Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) fails to arrive, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) heartbroken until a letter reveals Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) sprained her ankle.
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

_Sources: [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P10](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0010), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P57](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0057), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P62](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0062)_

> Before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) leaves for town with [Dora](../character/dora.md), she and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talk with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) about behaving well. Left alone to do chores, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally dyes her nose red with rug dye instead of applying freckle lotion, right as [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) unexpectedly arrives with Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md). [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) save the day by bringing chicken for dinner, and the guests enjoy a delightful meal and a walk through the woods before departing.
>
> — v2 · XX The Way It Often Happens
